messages:
anya: kicking off intake for verdant-13b (new open-weight from partner). goal is production-ready perf profile: throughput/latency baselines + int8 quant smoke + ctx sweep. owners: @michael (bench), @jess (latency tuning), @ops (infra). please follow checklist below and post runs here.

michael: got it. i'll do fp16 baseline first then int8 fast path. target SLO for single-token p95 at seq=512 is ~220ms; is that still the product bar?

anya: yes that's the bar for v1 endpoints. for long context we care more about sustained throughput and memory. also measure ttfb for streaming.

jess: couple notes: include warmup pattern (10k tokens) to populate KV cache, run ctx sweep [512,1024,2048,4096,8192], and batching profile [1,4,8,16]. measure both p50/p95 and tokens/sec. capture GPU util and memory.

michael: plan:
```
# run template
bench-run --model verdant-13b --mode fp16 --ctx 2048 --batch 4 --warmup 10000 --output json > verdant_fp16_2048_b4.json
bench-run --model verdant-13b --mode int8 --ctx 2048 --batch 4 --warmup 10000 --output json > verdant_int8_2048_b4.json
```
I'll tag tests with run_id and push artifacts to s3:/bench/verdant/1710854321/

perf-bot: automated-smoke: started quick int8 probe (batch=1, ctx=512)
perf-bot: command: `bench-run --model verdant-13b --mode int8 --ctx 512 --batch 1 --warmup 2000`
perf-bot: results: tokens/sec=420, p50=46ms, p95=180ms, mem=12.8GB, gpu_util=62%

jess: early note: int8 p95 180ms @ctx512 looks promising. do a quick compare fp16->int8 for degradation in autoregressive quality (perp / prompt-completion mismatch) with our eval set.

michael: will run evals after perf runs. estimated total run time ~3h for full sweep on one machine. ops, can we reserve capacity?

ops: we have capacity Thurs 10:00-14:00 PT on 4x A100-80GBs and Friday 02:00-06:00 PT on 6x A100. reserving Thu slot for primary runs. please confirm node count.

anya: reserve 4 for now, if michael needs more escalate to me. also add one golden baseline run pinned to our catalog model id to keep comparisons stable.

michael: confirmed. i'll start Thu 10:00 PT. will attach raw JSON + perf summary + short note on any regressions.

jess: checklist reminder for the thread: 1) fp16 baseline 2) int8 quant smoke 3) ctx sweep 4) batching sweep 5) ttfb/streaming checks 6) quality evals (prompt set) 7) upload artifacts + dashboard PR 8) rollback plan if regressions > threshold

anya: perfect. if any failing perf targets or quality drop >3% on eval, tag me and we'll triage. thanks everyone :rocket:

ops: noted. i'll post reservation id and ssh bastion info tomorrow morning.
